DetailedDescription: In China it was confirmed that 150mg Erlotinib was effective in NSCLC patients wtih EGFR mutation, but reducing dose occurring in some patients because of the drug related side-effects. Thus, we sought to investigate that in Chinese patients with EGFR mutation whether low dose (100mg) Erlotinib had similar efficacy but lower toxcities compared with standad dose (150mg) Erlotinib.
InclusionGenesStatus: Exon 18 mutation; Exon 19 deletion; L858R mutation positive
Purpose: The purpose of this study is to determine whether 100mg erlotinib had similar effect compared with 150mg erlotinib in NSCLC patients with EGFR mutation in China.
ResponsibleParty: Jianxing He, The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University
Sponsor: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University
Title: Erlotinib 100mg or 150mg in Treating EGFR Mutated NSCLC
